text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished her primary goal, the Mile Championship,
Daring Heart showed no sign of taking a break, stoically continuing her training.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Good work! That's it for today.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Well then, see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm gonna party with everyone!
After all, it's Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We're throwing an ugly sweater party! ♪
I'm planning to wear the absolute tackiest one
that I brought from home!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Covered in lights, and the colors are totally gaudy! There's even a snowman popping out of the shoulder—pretty amazing, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Okay, I get it now. You—
you were planning to ask me out
on a Christmas date, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, too bad! I'm a busy girl, you know.
You have to ask me much earlier than this!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
………………Wait, really?
Are you for real?
choice_data_list: N-No way! There's no way that's serious—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was for real. It wasn't a date, but...
She had prepared a modest party for her, to celebrate how hard she'd worked to get this far.
choice_data_list: (Telling me it's meant to be a surprise...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I had just given up on
inviting her from the start.
—After all, she's ridiculously popular.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ――STOP!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for having me ♪
You put up some wonderful decorations!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask?
When you give such an obvious reaction, how could I not?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You're far too modest.
Even after preparing all of this so thoroughly for me...
choice_data_list: By the way... what about the sweater party?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "The contest just wrapped up! And naturally, I took home the title of Most Ugly."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: So I slipped away. ...It felt like someone was waiting for me, after all?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"So... how do I look?
I dressed up properly for the occasion."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Wait, is that it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Take a closer look, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Look...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —How do I look to you... right now?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Okay, I'll let that satisfy me!
Come on, go on with your party, will you?"
choice_data_list: Still... I can't guarantee you'll have fun, you know?
Still... I can't guarantee you'll have fun, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Jeez.
Still don't get it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm spending it with you—
no matter what we do, it's fun.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Mmh~, it's delicious!
Roast chicken really is the best!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Even so... Honey-baked ham, mac and cheese, glazed carrots—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And even a "Derby Pie"!
This is packed with nuts and so delicious, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"This is pretty close to the Christmas dishes from my hometown.
Did you go out of your way to look it up?"
choice_data_list: I just wanted to experience it myself.
I wanted to be the one to experience it

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I see.
So, now that you've tried it... did you like it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“Still, just a meal would be a waste.
When you think of Christmas, it's got to be—”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's time to open presents!
—Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, I'm taking a video!
I'm expecting a good reaction!♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Upon opening the box, what was inside was—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You're always seriously pondering
about so many different things, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So... I wanted you to clear your head once in a while
and spend some time relaxing and unwinding.
choice_data_list: ...Thank you, I'll make good use of it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Geez, can't you give a bigger reaction?
That's not gonna look good on video, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"More like... 'Oh my gosh!'
Kind of feel. ...You can do that, right?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Nice reaction!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So... of course you've
prepared one too, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, there are a few, but... first off—
Yeah, there are a few, but... first off—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wait!
Time to switch photographers♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey.
Just how old do you think I am?"
choice_data_list: No, I'm not treating you like a child...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In America, Christmas is traditionally spent with family.
However, ever since coming to the Academy,
she must hardly have had time for that.
choice_data_list: That's why... I wanted you to feel that warmth.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...In that case, it's a huge success.
Because right now... it feels so warm."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much.
...I will treasure this."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tremble tremble...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: …………Oh, it's from a friend.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Aren't you home yet?" ...is what it says.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I should be heading back soon. Thanks for a fun time!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —From here on out, it's my time♪

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! Trainer-san is here~!"
"Hey there, star of the day!" "Come on, step right up!"
"Over here, over here~♡"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: What are you talking about? You're going to be one of us!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Someone, please bring Trainer
a sweater that fits perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"What's this? Full-body illuminations, 3D reindeer and Santa front and back, plus it even plays video!
Here you go, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the Christmas night drew on amidst the merry lively atmosphere—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Sorry, I'm heading out for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Right then, a question popped into my head.
I hadn't mentioned anything about the party,
so why was she holding a present?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text: "—So, how did it go? Did your Trainer say you looked super cute?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That's a tricky spot.
They did say it felt good, though.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh, what's that!
Well, it does sound like something you'd say, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text: "Still, I'm really glad for you! Your Trainer was planning to spend Christmas with you all along."

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text:
"Heart, you've been wondering about it this whole time, haven't you?
About... what we're going to do for Christmas."

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"Right?! Going to such a fancy, mature place to pick out a present with all her heart...
It was so utterly devoted, my heart went wild!"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend D
text_block_list.text: "We hadn't gotten any invitations even the day before, so we gave up and just had our own party... Talk about a massive comeback victory♡, right?"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, why didn't you just ask straight up?
You should've just gone all-in like you always do!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...I just wanted you to invite me.
I mean, wouldn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's no fun if it's always
just about me, you know?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text: "So, you were confident after all, weren't you? That's our Heart, so cool~♡"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind waiting as long as it takes, so you go enjoy yourself all the way to the end~!
See ya later!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Bye♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Calling it 'boring'... I was just putting on a brave face, wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I really... just wanted
to be invited, that's all."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure... it doesn't mean anything special.
To them, I'm just a little girl who suits stuffed animals. But――)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Worried when she didn't return for a while,
I went to look for her... and found her outside.
I hastily unwrapped my scarf—”
choice_data_list: You'll catch a cold... Let's head back soon.
You'll catch a cold... Let's head back soon.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine. You know that too, don't you?
I'm strong. So—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Let us take our time.
Slow and steady... okay?
